description: Copart (US) salvage and used vehicle auctions for a search (make, model, year...): lot number, vehicle title, odometer and its status, title type and state, primary damage, keys, AutoGrade score, yard location, auction timing/status, current bid (USD) and lot link, 20 to 50 lots per search.
